title: CPF Module Schema: Private DNS Zone Module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-privatednszone'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

private_dns_zone_name.description: (Required) The name of the Private DNS Zone. • Name must have `1-63 characters`, `2 to 34 labels`, Each label is a set of characters separated by a period. For example, contoso.com has 2 labels.

private_dns_zone_vnet_links.type: map(object({ vnet_id = string registration_enabled = optional(bool, false) }))
private_dns_zone_vnet_links.description: "(Optional) Map containing Private DNS Zone vnet links Objects." map(object({ vnet_id = (Required) The ID of the Virtual Network that should be linked to the DNS Zone. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. registration_enabled = (Optional) Is auto-registration of virtual machine records in the virtual network in the Private DNS zone enabled ? }))

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

soa_record.type: object({ email = string expire_time = optional(string) minimum_ttl = optional(number) refresh_time = optional(number) retry_time = optional(number) ttl = optional(number) })
soa_record.description: "(Required) An `soa_record` for the Private DNS Zone. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." object({ email = (Required) The email contact for the SOA record. expire_time = (Optional) The expire time for the SOA record. Defaults to 2419200. minimum_ttl = (Optional) The minimum Time To Live for the SOA record. By convention, it is used to determine the negative caching duration. Defaults to 300. refresh_time = (Optional) The refresh time for the SOA record. Defaults to 3600. retry_time = (Optional) The retry time for the SOA record. Defaults to 300. ttl = (Optional) The Time To Live of the SOA Record in seconds. Defaults to 3600. })

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

dns_zone_vnet_link_ids.description: Resource IDs of the Private DNS Zone Virtual Network Link.

dns_zone_vnet_link_ids_map.description: Map of Resource IDs of the Private DNS Zone Virtual Network Link.

id.description: The ID of the Private DNS Zone.

name.description: The name of the Private DNS Zone.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Privatednszone' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
